text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Libyan army chief Abu Bakr Jaber Yunes said after a meeting with Tunisian President Ben Ali in Tunis that economic cooperation between Tunisia and Libya would be boosted during the next few months.
- Junior minister at agriculture ministry Chadli Laroussi said Tunisia will have self-sufficiency in milk production by the year 2001.
- Tunisia and Indonesia want to boost cooperation in the agriculture sector.
- Plastic industry exhibit to start on Wednesday in Tunis.
- Tunisia to participate in a Euro-Mediterranean investment conference to be held in London on March 6-7.
